units.source_text: 阿光方才已经问过阿留的住处，现在再次探问，她意识到自己心不在焉，也就不好意思了。

en.t: Aguang had already asked where Aliu lived just a moment ago, and now that she asked again, she realized she had not been paying attention and felt embarrassed.

units.source_text: 阿留却全然不放在心上。

en.t: Aliu, however, did not take it to heart at all.
